quotes.text: The album has different sounds, different stories, but is always straight.
It is close to their best 1990s productions. The songs make you want to sing and shout to the songs, some want to make you head-banging.
40 years after, they still do what they can do best – great rock music!
originally a punk band, their first album Der nette Mann has been put on the German media index and was even seized after publication as it contains violent language.
the 1996 album E.I.N.S. is likely one of the best German rock albums of the 1990s.
the band wrote some very classic German rock songs, like Mexiko (about the 1986 Soccer World Championship) or Auf gute Freunde ("To good friends").
They aren't as experimental as on the predecessor but they're full of the attitude that rocked this country for the last 40 years.
The songs themselves are mostly filling material, standard songs and copies of older songs, mostly without any creativity.
Especially drums and guitars would sound very uninspired throughout the whole album.
